title: Drop Identity Sequence
description: A reference-led merch-and-ticket sequence establishing one tour graphic language and propagating it across poster, ticket, apparel, and wristband surfaces.
creative_direction: The root image establishes an owned graphic identity for a tour drop: one emblem, one color system, one portrait or mascot cue, and one collector-grade mood. Subsequent images preserve that language across different physical products and ticket surfaces.

generation_plan.ref_strategy: Run 01-reference-drop-poster first. Use its runtime result URL as --ref for 02-ticket-pack-variant, 03-shirt-fold-variant, 04-wristband-variant. Queue may run 02-ticket-pack-variant, 03-shirt-fold-variant, 04-wristband-variant concurrently after 01-reference-drop-poster is done.
generation_plan.index_policy: Only status=done images with image.png are included in works/index.json.
